acceptedAnswer.text: Profile changes can move rankings within weeks. Meaningful movement across a service area usually takes three to six months. Anyone promising faster is guessing.

acceptedAnswer.text: You do. Profile, citations, phone numbers, and any pages we built. We hand it over and remove our access.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with my competitors?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. One contractor per trade, per service area. When your slot is filled, it is filled until that client leaves.

acceptedAnswer.text: We build it. $5,500 standalone, $4,000 if you are on any monthly plan, six weeks either way. Service pages, city pages, schema, lead capture, and call tracking are part of the build, not add-ons — and you own it outright.

mainEntity.name: What if my Google profile gets suspended?

acceptedAnswer.text: We handle reinstatement for $1,200, and you pay only if it is restored.

Because they all win jobs the same way: a homeowner searches the map, calls the top three, and books a quote. One playbook, executed properly, beats twenty playbooks executed adequately. If your trade is not on the list, ask — if the marketing path matches, it qualifies.

mainEntity.name: What does one contractor per trade, per territory mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: We take one roofer in Scottsdale, one window company in Mesa, one garage door company in Chandler — never two of the same trade in the same market. Your monthly fee never funds your competitor.
